name: food-delivery-monorepo
description: Local helper only — runs FoodDash frontend + backend together. Push frontend/ and backend/ to SEPARATE GitHub repos for Netlify + Render.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
